name: Bingshan Refrigeration & Heat Transfer Technologies Co., Ltd.
summary: Bingshan Refrigeration & Heat Transfer Technologies Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the design, manufacturing, sale, installation, and maintenance of refrigeration, heating, and air conditioning equipment in China and internationally. The company offers piston type, screw type, vortex type, and lithium bromide absorption refrigeration machines/units, as well as pressure vessels, combination warehouses, controlled atmosphere fresh-keeping warehouses, refrigeration stations, quick freezing machines, and heat pumps.
